what_happened: On a multi-lane highway the route command was RIGHT, but the ego's plan bent left and it drifted toward the adjacent left lane while slowing to about 4.4 m/s. Actor 41 was passing in that lane, and the ego's front-left corner hit it about 1.6 m left of the recorded path.

On the multi-lane highway, the ego slowed and steered left toward the next lane, even though the command was RIGHT and the recorded drive stayed in lane. Vehicle 41 was traveling alongside in that lane, and the ego's front hit it at 7.7s.

On a wet multi-lane highway the route command changed to RIGHT, but the ego drifted left out of its lane instead. Its front hit actor 41, a white pickup driving in the lane to its left (front collision at 7.7 s, ego about 1.7 m left of the recorded path).

On a multi-lane highway with the route command STRAIGHT and then RIGHT, the ego's plan bent left, away from the logged path, and it moved into the lane to its left. Its front hit the white pickup (actor 41), which was driving alongside and slightly ahead in that lane.

On a multi-lane highway, the ego slowed from 6.7 to 4.4 m/s and drifted left toward the next lane, even though the route command was STRAIGHT and then RIGHT. Car 41 was passing on the left and had just moved slightly ahead, and the ego's front corner cut into it.

On a clear multi-lane highway, the policy braked hard for no visible reason (23.7 to 6.8 m/s, with the lead 40+ m ahead and pulling away) while its path wandered left. Actor 1, a replayed vehicle in the left lane that had been behind, came up alongside, and the ego's front-left corner swung into it at 7.6 s.

On a clear highway with the nearest car ahead 40–53 m away, the policy braked hard for no visible reason (23.7 → 6.7 m/s) and drifted left off the recorded path. Actor 1, coming up in the left lane, was beside the ego when the ego's front-left corner swung into it. The ego was also rear-ended at some point, which fits a car following behind it while it braked for nothing.

On a straight highway with no lead closer than 40 m, the policy braked hard for no reason (23.7 to 7.1 m/s) while drifting left. Actor 1 caught up in the left lane, and the ego's front-left clipped it as the two came alongside. The sudden slowdown also likely caused the separate rear contact from traffic behind.

On an open highway with no lead vehicle within 40 m, the ego braked hard for no clear reason, slowing from 23.7 to 6.9 m/s, and drifted left toward the next lane. Actor 1 was passing on the left at that moment, and the ego's front-left corner hit its side.
